enriched_description: Gambling machine with upright rectangular cabinet housing a vertical display screen or mechanical reels. Front panel features a coin/bill acceptor slot, a prominent lever on the right side (one-armed bandit), and a payout tray at the bottom. Display shows spinning reel symbols (fruits, bars, sevens) arranged in a 3x3 or 5x3 grid. Cabinet constructed from molded plastic and metal with illuminated graphics and flashing LED lights. Typical dimensions approximately 1.5m tall, 0.6m wide.

Breathing tube device consisting of a J-shaped or L-shaped hollow tube approximately 30-40 cm in length. Upper end features a splash guard or dry-top valve mechanism. Lower end has a curved mouthpiece made of soft silicone or rubber with a bite tab. Tube diameter approximately 2-2.5 cm interior bore. Typically constructed from flexible plastic or silicone in bright colors (yellow, blue, orange). Attaches to diving mask via a keeper clip or elastic loop.

Tracked winter vehicle with elongated low-profile body. Front features two narrow skis mounted on suspension A-arms for steering. Rear driven by continuous rubber track with deep lugs for snow traction. Rider sits on a single or two-person seat above the chassis. Handlebar steering controls with thumb throttle. Windshield deflects snow spray. Body panels typically brightly colored (red, blue, yellow) with snowflake or mountain graphics. Engine housed beneath the hood at the front. Overall length approximately 2.5-3.5m.

Heavy-duty vehicle equipped with a large wide blade mounted to the front. Blade is typically V-shaped or straight, constructed from reinforced steel, spanning 2-4 meters in width. Blade angles downward at approximately 30-45 degrees to push snow. Mounting frame connects to truck chassis via hydraulic lift arms. Vehicle body is typically a heavy-duty truck (pickup or larger) in yellow, orange, or white with amber warning lights on the roof. Blade surface shows wear marks from road contact.

Compact dispensing device with a reservoir container and pump mechanism. Body typically cylindrical or rectangular, constructed from plastic or stainless steel. Top features a push-down pump head or automatic sensor window. Nozzle or spout extends from the front or top. Capacity typically 200-500ml. Wall-mounted or freestanding. Surface may be glossy or matte finish in white, chrome, or translucent colors. Push-type models have a spring-loaded plunger; automatic models have an infrared sensor lens visible on the front face.

Spherical inflated ball approximately 22 cm in diameter (size 5). Surface composed of 32 panels (20 hexagons and 12 pentagons) stitched or thermally bonded together. Classic pattern features black pentagons on white background, though modern variants use multi-color panels. Surface texture is slightly pebbled for grip. Valve stem visible at one panel junction. Material is synthetic leather (PU or PVC) with a smooth but textured finish. Weight approximately 410-450 grams when properly inflated.

Tubular knitted garment covering the foot and extending up the leg to between ankle and knee. Constructed from cotton, wool, or synthetic blend with ribbed cuff at the top for elastic grip. Toe area is reinforced with thicker stitching. Heel section is shaped with a distinct cup-like contour. Surface shows knit pattern (ribbed, argyle, or solid). Colors and patterns vary widely. Ankle socks extend just above the shoe line; crew socks reach mid-calf. Fabric exhibits slight stretch and conforms to foot shape.

Large concave parabolic reflector dish, typically 1-10 meters in diameter. Surface consists of highly polished mirrored panels or reflective metallic coating arranged in a precise parabolic curve. Dish is mounted on a tracking frame with dual-axis pivot for following the sun. Central focal point features a receiver or heat exchanger positioned at the convergence of reflected rays. Support structure is a steel framework painted white or silver. The dish interior appears brilliantly reflective, while the exterior back is matte-finished.

Wide-brimmed straw hat with a tall, rounded crown. Brim extends 30-60 cm radially from the crown, providing extensive sun protection. Crown is approximately 15-20 cm tall with a slightly domed top. Constructed from woven palm fiber or straw in natural tan or light brown color. Brim edge may feature decorative stitching or braided trim. Underside of brim shows woven texture. Chin cord (barboquejo) may be attached beneath the crown. Overall silhouette is distinctly circular with a prominent central peak.

Deep rounded ceramic or porcelain bowl designed for serving liquid soups. Diameter approximately 15-20 cm with depth of 6-8 cm. Walls curve inward from a wide rim to a narrower base. Rim may be smooth or feature a subtle lip for spoon resting. Exterior surface is glazed in solid colors or decorative patterns. Interior is glossy white or matching glaze. Some variants have two small handles on opposite sides. Base has an unglazed foot ring. Capacity typically 300-500ml.
